segments.oily: A few reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin found the cream too thick or not suited to them, though one with oily, acne-prone skin said it was non-pore-clogging and helped restore her barrier.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin mostly report the cream relieves flaking, dullness and winter dryness, though one dry-skin reviewer reported new pimples after use.
segments.combination: The two reviewers who identify combination skin report it works well and does not break them out.
segments.sensitive: The large majority of self-described sensitive-skin reviewers report the cream calms redness, irritation and reactivity without stinging, but a few report burning, itching or acne flare-ups.
segments.normal: No reviewer explicitly describes normal skin.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who names mature skin, using retinol and acid exfoliants, reports the cream calms post-exfoliation redness.

concerns.aging: One mature reviewer using retinol and acids reports the cream helps skin recover from exfoliation and supports her barrier; another nearing 50 credits it as part of her anti-aging routine.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers with dry or winter-dry skin report deep, lasting hydration and less flaking; one dry-skin reviewer nonetheless still had pimples appear.
concerns.redness: A large number of reviewers, mostly sensitive or rosacea-prone, report visibly reduced redness within days, including after shaving, laser hair removal or exfoliation; one reviewer instead reports a new reaction and redness around her eyes.
concerns.barrier: Many reviewers with a 'compromised' or reactive barrier report fewer flare-ups, less burning with actives, and visible barrier repair over weeks; no reviewer disputes this specifically.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the cream reduced redness left by old acne scarring; not otherwise discussed.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report the cream did not cause breakouts even with acne-prone or hormonal-acne skin, but multiple others report it caused new pimples, cystic-type breakouts or scaly patches.
concerns.oiliness: A couple of reviewers describe the formula as too thick or heavy for oily skin and not ideal for that skin type.
